'''2007 Worlds Day 1 Adam Howland DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Adam Howland]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Adam Howland]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif|label=My Lord, Is That Legal?}}
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
